errors.evidence: The description states there are four banks, but the chart and legend clearly show five banks (УниКредит Булбанк, Банка ДСК, ПИБ, Пощенска банка, ОББ вкл. СИБ).
The description states there are four lines, but the chart clearly shows five lines, one for each of the five banks in the legend.

The line for "УниКредит Булбанк" ends at approximately 12% in 2027, not 10%. The point is clearly above the 11% grid line.
The line for "Банка ДСК" starts at approximately 12% in 2007, not 9%.

errors.evidence: The line for "ПИБ" does not have a peak of 12% in 2016. Its highest point is around 11% in the period 2017-2019. In 2016, its value is approximately 9.5%.
The line for "ОББ вкл. СИБ" has 'x'-shaped markers (кръстосани маркери), not triangle markers. The triangle markers belong to "Пощенска банка".
